title: The Double Cipher
author: Cyrus Blackwood
blurb: Sebastian Underhill, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
